description: Remove every face indexed from one photo. Soft by default (restore_photo undoes it); immediate=true or compliance=true is permanent. Deleting a photo that is already gone still succeeds. Free.

collection_id.description: Collection id, e.g. an event or album id. Any text except '/', '\', '.' and '..'.

photo_id.description: The photo_id used when the photo was indexed.

name: delete_photo
title: Delete a photo's faces
